recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Reintroducing the older blanket SHALL wording would conflict with the issue's modified resolution and with later applied FHIR-41589 guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-13810 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 by Vocabulary. It requested version reporting for ValueSet expansion codes, but the accepted resolution narrowed that to conditional guidance because code-system versions are not always required or meaningful in every server context.
initial_application: SVN revision 13082 / git commit 458301bbf4dc45e5f1602d4f159dae0051829145 applied GF#13810 by adding ValueSet expansion-parameter prose to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml. The original application recorded that expansion parameters describe what controlled expansion and that a specified code-system version should be represented as an expansion parameter.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active build resource and its $expand operation is listed in the ValueSet operation list. FHIR-3535 introduced ValueSet.expansion.contains.version as optional, FHIR-14688 later clarified the per-code version definition without changing cardinality, FHIR-13820 handled the separate $expand valueSetVersion action item and is already represented on the combined branch, and later FHIR-41589/FHIR-41639 replaced the older GF#13810 sentence with the current SHOULD-level expansion-parameter categories and used-* response parameters.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The latest combined source already says ValueSet.expansion.parameter SHOULD include canonical or URI references, including version, for all CodeSystems, CodeSystem Supplements, and ValueSets used in the expansion; persisted expansions SHALL include the full parameter set; used-system records system|version when available; and ValueSet.expansion.contains.version remains optional with SHOULD-level guidance when code meaning is not guaranteed to be stable.

related_jiras.note: Introduced optional ValueSet.expansion.contains.version for code systems where version matters.
Tracked the separate $expand value-set version parameter action item and is already represented on the combined branch.
Clarified the meaning of optional ValueSet.expansion.contains.version without changing cardinality.
Replaced the older GF#13810 expansion-parameter sentence with the current SHOULD category list after R6 Vocabulary review.
Added used-system, used-supplement, and used-valueset response-only accounting parameters for expansion inputs.
